challenges.title: Your first sandpile
challenges.prompt: Draw sand and watch it find a slope.
challenges.learningPoint: Grains settle and form a stable angle.
challenges.modelLimitations: Cells stand in for many real grains.
challenges.fictionBoundary: No invented reaction is used.
hints: Build until you have 24 sand cells.

challenges.title: A pocket of rain
challenges.prompt: Pour water over a little ridge.
challenges.learningPoint: Liquids flow toward available lower spaces.
challenges.modelLimitations: Viscosity and pressure are simplified.
challenges.fictionBoundary: The grid is a game-sized world.
hints: Build until you have 18 water cells.

challenges.title: Freeze the drip
challenges.prompt: Cool water until ice appears.
challenges.learningPoint: Water changes phase when thermal energy changes.
challenges.modelLimitations: Temperature is represented by a tool event.
challenges.fictionBoundary: The cold token is not a real substance.
hints: Build until you have 6 ice cells.

challenges.title: Steam signal
challenges.prompt: Warm water and catch a rising cloud.
challenges.learningPoint: Water can change from liquid to gas.
challenges.modelLimitations: Boiling pressure and temperature are omitted.
challenges.fictionBoundary: The heat brush is an abstract control.
hints: Build until you have 6 steam cells.

challenges.title: Pause a waterfall
challenges.prompt: Pause, place water, then advance one tick.
challenges.learningPoint: A fixed step lets us inspect change one moment at a time.
challenges.modelLimitations: The simulation advances in discrete ticks.
challenges.fictionBoundary: Ticks are a model, not time itself.
hints: Build until you have 10 water cells.

challenges.title: Undo the spill
challenges.prompt: Make a spill, then undo and rebuild it.
challenges.learningPoint: A command log can reproduce and reverse user actions.
challenges.modelLimitations: Undo tracks commands, not every internal event.
challenges.fictionBoundary: No chemistry claim is made.
hints: Build until you have 8 oil cells.

challenges.title: Make a polite fart
challenges.prompt: Combine food gel and a friendly microbe.
challenges.learningPoint: Gases spread into available space.
challenges.modelLimitations: Biology and reaction kinetics are omitted.
challenges.fictionBoundary: This is deliberately not a real recipe.
hints: Build until you have 6 game stink cells.

challenges.title: Grow impossible hair
challenges.prompt: Feed a seed until fibers climb upward.
challenges.learningPoint: Fibers are long structures made from repeating units.
challenges.modelLimitations: Growth is a visual polymer analogy.
challenges.fictionBoundary: It does not simulate a body.
hints: Build until you have 12 hair fiber cells.

challenges.title: Build a tiny toilet
challenges.prompt: Shape a bowl and guide water through it.
challenges.learningPoint: A siphon can move liquid through a bent path.
challenges.modelLimitations: Air pressure and pipe geometry are compressed.
challenges.fictionBoundary: The completion detector is a game rule.
hints: Build until you have 18 ceramic cells.

challenges.title: Matter makes music
challenges.prompt: Send a pulse through a metal string.
challenges.learningPoint: Sound begins with vibration and travels through matter.
challenges.modelLimitations: Frequency is quantized into colored pulses.
challenges.fictionBoundary: Materials do not create melody from nothing.
hints: Build until you have 4 music particle cells.

challenges.title: Rainbow laundry
challenges.prompt: Mix two dyes into a foam cloud.
challenges.learningPoint: Mixtures can combine optical effects.
challenges.modelLimitations: Color mixing is screen-based.
challenges.fictionBoundary: Rainbow foam is fictional.
hints: Try dye cyan with dye pink.
Build until you have 8 rainbow foam cells.

challenges.title: Moon-sand castle
challenges.prompt: Stack sand that refuses to fall.
challenges.learningPoint: Material behavior depends on interactions between particles.
challenges.modelLimitations: Cohesion is a binary rule.
challenges.fictionBoundary: Moon Sand here is invented.
hints: Build until you have 20 moon sand cells.

challenges.title: The upside-down drip
challenges.prompt: Use Up-Gel to make matter rise.
challenges.learningPoint: Density and forces influence motion.
challenges.modelLimitations: Only vertical cell movement is modeled.
challenges.fictionBoundary: Anti-gravity gel is fictional.
hints: Build until you have 10 antigravity gel cells.

challenges.title: Portal plumbing
challenges.prompt: Move water across the lab without a pipe.
challenges.learningPoint: System boundaries decide where matter may move.
challenges.modelLimitations: Transport is an instantaneous mapping.
challenges.fictionBoundary: Portals are fictional.
hints: Build until you have 4 portal dust cells.

challenges.title: Feed the monster
challenges.prompt: Layer goo, gel, and fizz into a face.
challenges.learningPoint: Complex patterns can emerge from simple placement rules.
challenges.modelLimitations: No biology is simulated.
challenges.fictionBoundary: The monster is entirely fictional.
hints: Try monster goo with food gel.
Build until you have 16 monster goo cells.

challenges.title: Density stack
challenges.prompt: Layer syrup, water, and oil.
challenges.learningPoint: Liquids of different densities can form layers.
challenges.modelLimitations: Mixing and surface tension are simplified.
challenges.fictionBoundary: Stable layers are accelerated for play.
hints: Build until you have 12 syrup cells.

challenges.title: Graphite path
challenges.prompt: Bridge a battery with graphite.
challenges.learningPoint: Graphite can conduct electricity.
challenges.modelLimitations: Resistance and voltage are not numerically modeled.
challenges.fictionBoundary: Charge is shown as a visible token.
hints: Build until you have 4 electricity cells.

challenges.title: Copper circuit
challenges.prompt: Complete a bright copper loop.
challenges.learningPoint: A closed conductive path allows current.
challenges.modelLimitations: The circuit is topological, not quantitative.
challenges.fictionBoundary: Light tokens mark success.
hints: Build until you have 4 light cells.

challenges.title: Salt disappears
challenges.prompt: Dissolve salt into moving water.
challenges.learningPoint: Dissolving disperses ions through a solvent.
challenges.modelLimitations: Ions are not individually represented.
challenges.fictionBoundary: The visual disappearance is accelerated.
hints: Build until you have 24 water cells.

challenges.title: Oil keeps its distance
challenges.prompt: Pour oil and water into one vessel.
challenges.learningPoint: Oil and water tend not to mix and can separate by density.
challenges.modelLimitations: Emulsions are omitted.
challenges.fictionBoundary: Separation is exaggerated.
hints: Build until you have 12 oil cells.

challenges.title: Ice afloat
challenges.prompt: Make ice and watch where it settles.
challenges.learningPoint: Ordinary ice is less dense than liquid water.
challenges.modelLimitations: Buoyancy is cell-based.
challenges.fictionBoundary: Phase change timing is a game rule.
hints: Build until you have 8 ice cells.

challenges.title: Diffusion cloud
challenges.prompt: Release dye into still water.
challenges.learningPoint: Particles spread from concentrated regions over time.
challenges.modelLimitations: Diffusion is much faster than in reality.
challenges.fictionBoundary: Colored cells are a visualization.
hints: Build until you have 10 dye pink cells.

challenges.title: Same carbon, new structure
challenges.prompt: Compare graphite with a crystal lattice.
challenges.learningPoint: Structure can strongly affect properties even when elements overlap.
challenges.modelLimitations: The crystal is a generic teaching stand-in.
challenges.fictionBoundary: No claim that this tool manufactures diamond.
hints: Build until you have 10 crystal cells.

challenges.title: Heat bridge
challenges.prompt: Carry heat along a metal path.
challenges.learningPoint: Metals often conduct heat more readily than insulating materials.
challenges.modelLimitations: Heat capacity is qualitative.
challenges.fictionBoundary: Heat tokens are visible game markers.
hints: Build until you have 6 heat cells.

challenges.title: Drum skin
challenges.prompt: Strike a stretched rubber surface.
challenges.learningPoint: A struck surface vibrates and launches sound waves.
challenges.modelLimitations: The waveform has no calibrated amplitude.
challenges.fictionBoundary: Pulse colors are artistic.
hints: Build until you have 6 sound pulse cells.

challenges.title: High note, low note
challenges.prompt: Compare short and long vibrating wires.
challenges.learningPoint: Vibrating length influences frequency.
challenges.modelLimitations: Pitch uses three discrete bands.
challenges.fictionBoundary: The score is a game melody.
hints: Build until you have 8 sound pulse cells.

challenges.title: Switch chain
challenges.prompt: Carry charge through a controllable path.
challenges.learningPoint: Switches control whether a circuit path is complete.
challenges.modelLimitations: No dangerous electrical values are modeled.
challenges.fictionBoundary: Charge particles are fictional visuals.
hints: Build until you have 8 electricity cells.

challenges.title: Conveyor pulse
challenges.prompt: Move a signal from one portal to another.
challenges.learningPoint: Signals can be transformed while information persists.
challenges.modelLimitations: Transport delay is one tick.
challenges.fictionBoundary: Portals and music particles are fictional.
hints: Try portal dust with sound pulse.
Build until you have 6 music particle cells.

challenges.title: Bathroom symphony
challenges.prompt: Build a siphon that triggers a note.
challenges.learningPoint: Structures can couple fluid motion to vibration.
challenges.modelLimitations: Coupling is event-based.
challenges.fictionBoundary: The bathroom orchestra is playful fiction.
hints: Build until you have 8 music particle cells.

challenges.title: Tiny weather machine
challenges.prompt: Cycle water, steam, fog, and rain.
challenges.learningPoint: Water moves among phases in a cycle.
challenges.modelLimitations: Cloud formation and pressure are omitted.
challenges.fictionBoundary: The lab compresses a weather system into seconds.
hints: Build until you have 28 water cells.
